analysis.accumulated_energy: endpoint difference in ACSWDNB/ACLWDNB J m-2; mean flux difference is endpoint delta divided by elapsed seconds
analysis.accumulator_closure: compares each interval accumulator increment against current, previous, and endpoint-trapezoid flux times elapsed seconds; reports float32 ULP-based closure tolerance
analysis.accuracy_claim: none; this is a paired descriptive comparison, not a physical validation
analysis.cloud_radiative_effect: all-sky minus clear-sky flux within each scheme; TOA net is downward minus upward; reported difference is RRTMGP minus RRTMG
analysis.heating_conversion: RTHRAT* source K s-1 multiplied by 86400 to potential-temperature tendency K day-1; profiles reported per layer with no vertical averaging
analysis.initialization_record: excluded from active flux/heating temporal metrics; retained as accumulator baseline
analysis.spatial_variability_note: first-active/final gridpoint spread and paired-difference SE are descriptive only; they do not imply independent columns or confidence intervals. Homogeneous native-RRTMG random streams can repeat the same sample across columns, so grid size alone does not establish Monte Carlo convergence.
analysis.spatial_weighting: AREA2D weights; output requires identical positive area grids
analysis.temporal_weighting: uniform history records for temporal means; preceding-interval duration weights for spacetime bias/RMSE
